nights.title: Leire Martínez
nights.name: Leire Martínez
nights.extract: Leire Martínez Ochoa, is a Spanish singer, songwriter and was the lead vocalist of the band La Oreja de Van Gogh from 2008 to 2024.

nights.title: Caloncho
nights.name: Caloncho
nights.extract: Óscar Alfonso Castro, better known as Caloncho, is a Mexican musician and singer.

nights.title: David Bisbal Tour Eternos 2026
nights.name: David Bisbal
nights.extract: David Bisbal Ferre is a Spanish singer and actor. He gained his initial fame as the runner-up on the first edition of the reality television talent show Operación Triunfo.

nights.title: La Gusana Ciega - Claroscuro
nights.name: La Gusana Ciega
nights.extract: La Gusana Ciega is a Mexican alternative rock and pop-rock band composed of Daniel Gutiérrez, Germán Arroyo (drums), and Luis Ernesto Martínez "Lu" (bass).

nights.title: Carlos Sadness
nights.name: Carlos Sadness
nights.extract: Carlos Sadness is a Spanish singer, songwriter and illustrator.

nights.title: Espinoza Paz
nights.name: Espinoza Paz
nights.extract: Isidro Chávez Espinoza, better known as Espinoza Paz, is a Latin Grammy nominated Mexican musician and songwriter of regional Mexican music.

nights.title: Silvio Rodríguez
nights.name: Silvio Rodríguez
nights.extract: Silvio Rodríguez Domínguez is a Cuban musician, and leader of the Nueva Trova movement.
